hed: Friday at the lake: cool fall air with highs in the low 30s
deck: Friday, October 9 brings a crisp fall day to Branson with highs around 32°F, lows near 17°F, and almost no chance of rain. Bundle up for outdoor adventures on Table Rock Lake or enjoy indoor shows and dining.

pick.title: Indoor Branson Shows
pick.why: With cool temperatures, head indoors for high-energy music, comedy, and family entertainment at one of Branson's legendary theaters.

shows.name: Absolutely Country, Definitely Gospel
shows.desc: Uplifting country and gospel to start the day. Warm, family-friendly, and soulful.

shows.name: Beach Boys California Dreamin'
shows.desc: Sunny surf-rock harmonies and classic Beach Boys hits. Ideal family matinee.

shows.name: Clay Cooper's Country Express Show
shows.desc: Lively country, gospel, comedy, and dance — a Branson staple with multi-generational draw.

shows.name: #1 Hits of the 60s
shows.desc: Nostalgic 60s hits showcase — strong afternoon option for couples and multi-gen families.

shows.name: Baldknobbers Vintage Show
shows.desc: Branson's famous Baldknobbers (65+ years) bring country music and comedy with high-energy tradition.

shows.name: Dublin's Irish Tenors & The Celtic Ladies

shows.name: Outpost Opry Variety Show
shows.desc: Country, gospel, classic hits, comedy — music/comedy/dinner-style variety for a late-afternoon fill.

shows.name: Amazing Acrobats of Shanghai / Grand Shanghai Circus
shows.desc: World-class Chinese acrobatics, balancing, contortion, and high production values. Outstanding family evening show.

shows.name: The Haygoods
shows.desc: High-energy sibling family show with multi-instrumentals, choreography, and effects — one of Branson's strongest evening draws.

shows.name: Hamners' Unbelievable Variety Show
shows.desc: Fast-paced magic, music, comedy, acrobatics, and illusions. Always a solid evening pick.

shows.name: Hughes Music Show
shows.desc: Large-scale family live production with a big cast and high energy — strong evening headliner at Hughes.

shows.name: Legends in Concert
